services.description: Standard 30-minute visit with a general practitioner

services.name: Follow-up
services.description: Quick follow-up for an existing patient

faqs.insurance: We accept most major insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, and UnitedHealthcare. Please bring your card to your first visit.
faqs.parking: Free patient parking is available in the lot behind the building, accessible from Maple Street.
faqs.new patient: New patients should arrive 15 minutes early to complete intake forms. Please bring a photo ID and your insurance card.
faqs.prescription refill: For prescription refills, please contact your pharmacy directly and they will send us a refill request.
faqs.cancellation: We ask for 24 hours notice for cancellations. Same-day cancellations may incur a $25 fee.
